why: Reverts issue #526's inversion, leaving the recoil as the refusal-only cue it was as #516's `turret` arm. That is the SHAPE A READER EXPECTS from the file's history, which is what makes it worth pinning: the refusal reads only because the kick is something the player has already seen on every ordinary shot, so a recoil that appears exclusively when a shot is refused is a cue to be learned rather than an absence to be noticed -- the exact design the owner ruled against.
killedBy: barrel recoil (issue #526, parent #356) kicks on a SHOT and on a REFUSAL alike -- that is the whole ruling
